name: Grilled rice paper
summary: A rice sheet grilled crisp with toppings, then folded and eaten hot from the paper. It is the night-market snack to start with.
origin: A Da Lat street snack at the night-market stalls.
howToEat: Fold the sheet while it is hot and eat it from the paper.
where: Da Lat Night Market, in the centre, about 18:00–23:00.
seoTitle: Grilled rice paper — Da Lat banh trang nuong
